text:
Sam H: Heads-up — GovDeptX PO stuck in the marketplace portal. Procurement rejected our PO because the billing EIN doesn't match the registered entity. They want evidence of affiliation and an updated W9. Link: https://redwood.share/docs/gov-ein-pack.pdf
Ana P: Ugh. Do we have a signing-authority alias for this billing entity? Last time we used 'Redwood Inference LLC' but the PO shows 'Redwood AI, Inc.'
Luis M: I can pull the EIN registry snapshot and the last W9. give me ~30m.
GovBizBot: Automated check failed: EIN mismatch (PO EIN: 12-3456789, registered EIN: 98-7654321). Recommended actions: provide notarized affidavit OR update PO entity to match registered EIN.
Sam H: Procurement also asked for a reseller/affiliation letter from our partner (marketplace vendor relationship). That needs partner legal sign-off before they'll accept the PO.
Kate R: Legal here — I can draft an affidavit template, but we need the partner contact and confirmation of the notarized signer. @Ana P can you DM the partner contact?
Ana P: Sending partner contact to Kate now. Also note: some marketplace portals validate address + EIN combination strictly — could be an address normalization mismatch.
Luis M: Running export now: ```curl -s https://internal-registry/api/entities/redwood | jq .evidence``` — will DM the export and the last-submitted W9 PDF.
Sam H: Customer expects PO accepted by EOD tomorrow. If legal + ops can't unblock, we should escalate to the Marketplace Ops lead and our partner account manager.
Kate R: I'll draft affidavit and a short cover letter for procurement. ETA ~3h. If notarization is required we should confirm remote-notary acceptance in the portal.
Ana P: Quick checklist: 1) confirm canonical legal entity name 2) confirm EIN on docs 3) confirm billing address normalization 4) get partner letter and legal sign-off 5) re-submit PO.
Luis M: Docs found and uploaded to the ticket (TKT-4829). DMing Sam and Kate with links.
Sam H: Thanks — please post back here when you submit. If we hit portal validation again, we'll loop in marketplace ops and escalate to partner success. :thumbsup:
Kate R: Acknowledged. Will update thread after draft and send to partner for signature.
Ana P: I'll monitor the portal and watch for acceptance notifications.
Sam H: Appreciate the quick turnaround, folks.
__notes: Generated Slack thread for partnerships: marketplace procurement blocker requiring EIN/affiliation docs. Short, chatty messages; includes bot check and small code snippet.
